results.headline: India Opens Up Offshore Oil Hunt: Government to Share Risk

issues.claim: India has unveiled new rules for offshore oil and gas exploration, under its 'Samudra Manthan' scheme, committing to share drilling risks with private energy companies.
issues.detail: The provided source texts do not mention a 'Samudra Manthan' scheme or any government policy to share drilling risks with private companies. Source 1's headline mentions 'govt-sets-rules-for-84-084-cr-offshore-oil-hunt-to-share-drilling-risks', but the actual text of the article does not contain any information about this scheme or policy; it only lists the headline in the URL and then provides a list of unrelated news items.

issues.claim: This ₹84,084 crore initiative aims to boost domestic crude production and enhance energy security.
issues.detail: While the figure ₹84,084 crore appears in the URL of Source 1, the content of the source text does not describe this figure as an initiative or scheme, nor does it provide any context for what this amount represents.

results.notes: The story references a 'Samudra Manthan' scheme and specific risk-sharing policies that are entirely absent from the provided source texts. The source texts contain only headlines and snippets of unrelated news, making the central claims of the story impossible to verify.
